title: 第13章 我是绝世天才第14章 闹鬼的大平层
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
小财迷歪着小脑袋心中开始了思想斗争：
如果姐姐嫁给他，我们青云武馆以后就不用为钱操心了。
可是他们是师徒啊，师徒结合有违道德。
唉，好难选啊。
慕璃不知道一旁的妹妹脑袋瓜里居然一瞬间闪过了这么多念头，很有做师父的责任感，开口问道：“顾铮，昨天回去有没有继续练，有没有碰到什么问题？”
慕盼笑嘻嘻道：“大师侄，不要太急了，不要气馁，短时间内没进展是正常的。你师叔我当年也是花了大半年的时间才进入蕴息境。”
顾铮挠挠头：“那个……我已经练成第一周天了。”
“！！！！！？？？？？”
“？？？？？？？”
两姐妹都是一副不相信你在说笑的样子，慕璃条件反射般否定：“不可能！你昨天才刚拜师练武，不到一天就练成蛰龙吐纳法第一周天进入蕴息境？人仙转世都做不到！”
“大师侄，这种玩笑一点都不好笑。”慕盼板起小脸一副严肃的样子。
顾铮伸出手：“师父，要不，你摸摸？”
慕璃微微蹙眉，右手握住他的手腕，细细一感知，发现一股股内息就在徒弟体内窜动起来，在皮膜筋骨，五脏六腑中进行周天循环。
而只有蕴息境才能做到内息如意运转全身。
慕璃松手一掌贴住顾铮的胸口，这下感觉的更清晰，顾铮体内的内息强度的确已经达到了蕴息境的程度。
仿佛确认之后，慕璃倒吸一口凉气，心中翻起惊涛骇浪：“难以置信，匪夷所思，你居然真的不到一天就进入了蕴息境……”
“哈？”
慕盼自己亲手感知了一下，同样不敢置信：“姐姐，这是什么情况，你不是昨天才教他练武的吗？”
两姐妹面面相觑。
蕴息虽然是武道的第一个境界，可一点也不简单，那些花费几年时间才进入蕴息境的大有人在。

而顾铮，居然只用了一个晚上就进入了蕴息境，简直颠覆了她们的世界观。
慕璃武道天赋已经算是不错了，都花了半年时间才进入蕴息境，练武十年才是锻骨境，当然，这是资源不够的原因，若是资源足够，她至少可以进入练脏境。
一天进入蕴息境，在两女看来，是绝对不可能完成的事情。
绝对！
不可能！
可偏偏眼前就有人做到了！
慕盼俩忙问道：“大师侄，你怎么做到的，教教我。”
她练武的时间不比姐姐短多少，才刚刚进入锻骨境。
顾铮摇摇头：“我也不知道，我就练啊练就这样了。”
我是挂壁啊，这东西是能说的么？
“…………”慕盼。
content_en:
The little money fan tilted his little head and started an ideological struggle in his heart:
If my sister marries him, our Qingyun Martial Arts School won’t have to worry about money in the future.
But they are master and apprentice, and it is against morality to combine master and apprentice.
Oh, it’s so hard to choose.
Mu Li didn't know that so many thoughts were flashing through the mind of the sister beside her. She had a strong sense of responsibility as a master and asked, "Gu Zheng, did you continue practicing when you went back yesterday? Did you encounter any problems?"
Mu Pan smiled and said: "Master nephew, don't be too impatient and don't be discouraged. It's normal for there to be no progress in a short period of time. It also took your uncle and me more than half a year to enter the aura realm."
Gu Zheng scratched his head: "Well... I have already completed the first week of training."
"!!!!!??????"
"???????"
Both sisters looked like they didn't believe you were joking. Mu Li denied it reflexively: "Impossible! You just became a martial arts master yesterday, and in less than a day, you practiced the Hidden Dragon Breathing Technique and entered the Accumulation Realm on the first week? Even the reincarnation of a human immortal can't do it!"
"Master's nephew, this kind of joke is not funny at all." Mu Pan put on a serious face.
Gu Zheng stretched out his hand: "Master, how about you touch it?"
Mu Li frowned slightly and held his wrist with her right hand. After a closer look, she found that the inner breath was moving in the disciple's body, circulating in the skin, muscles, bones, and internal organs.
Only in the realm of accumulation of breath can the inner breath circulate throughout the body as desired.
Mu Lisong put a palm of his hand against Gu Zheng's chest, and now he felt more clearly that the intensity of the inner energy in Gu Zheng's body had indeed reached the level of Accumulation Realm.
As if after confirmation, Mu Li took a breath of cold air, and her heart was filled with turmoil: "It's unbelievable, unbelievable, you actually entered the aura realm in less than a day..."
"Huh?"
Mu Pan felt it with his own hands and was also in disbelief: "Sister, what is going on? Didn't you just teach him martial arts yesterday?"
The two sisters looked at each other.
Although Yunqi is the first realm of martial arts, it is not simple at all. There are many people who have spent several years entering the Yunqi realm.
Gu Zheng, on the other hand, actually entered the Yunxi realm in just one night, which completely overturned their worldview.
Mu Li's talent in martial arts is already pretty good. It took her half a year to enter the Immortal Realm. After practicing martial arts for ten years, she can reach the Bone Forging Realm. Of course, this is because of insufficient resources. If there are enough resources, she can at least enter the Zang Training Realm.
In the eyes of the two women, entering the Yunqi realm in one day is absolutely impossible.
absolute!
impossible!
But someone happened to do it right in front of me!
Mu Pan and his wife hurriedly asked: "Master nephew, how did you do it? Please teach me."
Her martial arts training time is not much shorter than that of her sister, and she has just entered the bone forging realm.
Gu Zheng shook his head: "I don't know either, I just practice and practice."
I am hanging it on the wall. Can this be said?
"..." Mu Pan.
